players.product: High-capacitance MLCCs (CGA/C series) for power-delivery decoupling

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025): net sales JPY 1,183,363 million (+8.6% YoY), operating profit JPY 147,627 million (+10.7%), profit before tax JPY 147,477 million (+7.4%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 111,406 million (+5.4%) - record highs. Management states sales rose in sensors, magnetic and energy on solid ICT and industrial-equipment component demand and tariff-driven pull-forward demand; nearline HDD demand for data centers stayed high, while BEV demand stayed weak and automotive component demand fell short of the initial assumption. FX reduced sales by about JPY 41.7 billion and operating profit by about JPY 9.2 billion (yen 4.4% stronger against the US dollar). H1 R&D expenses JPY 133,785 million (11.3% of sales).
